interest: Shows Japan's British-style fire-insurance rating adopted via F.O.C. policy, prompted by Rep. Tinkham's inquiry and a 1945 charge slip.
overview: This file (State Department decimal file 894.5061/8) concerns fire insurance regulations, rating practices, and tariff schedules in Japan in early 1933, compiled in response to a congressional inquiry from U.S. Representative George Holden Tinkham. The file consists of a State Department document file note cross-referencing Despatch No. 574, two versions of a three-page despatch from American Consul General Arthur Garrels in Tokyo dated February 2 and February 7, 1933, and a 1945 State Department charge slip documenting file circulation. Garrels' despatches examine the operations of foreign (American, British, French) and Japanese fire insurance companies, explaining how policies adapted the British Fire Offices' Committee (F.O.C.) standard policy, how premium rates followed the British 'class' system based on regional fire loss records (distinguishing between flat provincial rates such as in Nara Prefecture and multiple urban divisions within Tokyo), and listing enclosed specimen policy forms and the Japan General Tariff.

people.name: George Holden Tinkham
people.role: Member of Congress (U.S. Representative from Massachusetts)

subfiles.about: A State Department cross-reference sheet recording Despatch No. 574 from Arthur Garrels concerning Japanese fire insurance regulations and blank policy forms for Congressman Tinkham.
subfiles.summary: Indexes a February 1933 Garrels despatch on Japanese fire insurance rules and blank policy forms sent for Congressman Tinkham.
subfiles.title: Document File Note on Despatch No. 574 from Tokyo

subfiles.about: A consular despatch from Arthur Garrels detailing foreign and domestic fire insurance practices, policy conditions, and rating tariffs in Japan.
subfiles.from: Arthur Garrels, American Consul General in Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Garrels forwards sample fire insurance policies and Japan's General Tariff, explaining foreign insurers use an adapted British F.O.C. standard policy while Japanese policies mainly differ by covering forest fire risk, with British-style 'class' rating applied flatly by prefecture or, in Tokyo, across eight zones.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Consul General Arthur Garrels on Foreign Fire Insurance Companies (February 2, 1933)

subfiles.about: A finalized consular despatch from Arthur Garrels transmitting Japanese and foreign fire insurance policy forms and tariff schedules for Congressman Tinkham.
subfiles.from: Arthur Garrels, American Consul General in Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Garrels submits specimen fire insurance policies from American, British, French, and Japanese companies with Japan's General Tariff, noting Japanese forest-fire endorsements and the British 'class' rating system by construction grade and territory, offering further clarification if Tinkham has specific questions.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Consul General Arthur Garrels on Foreign Fire Insurance Companies (February 7, 1933)

subfiles.about: A Department of State charge slip tracking the borrowing and internal circulation of file 894.5061 in 1945.
subfiles.summary: Charge slip shows file 894.5061 and enclosures checked out in July and November 1945 to Noyes and others.
subfiles.title: State Department Charge Slip for File 894.5061
